listitem.simpara: Complete and polish project-wide documentation guidance.

chapter.simpara: Project documents are authored in DocBook 5.1. Use simpara as the default paragraph element. Indent with two spaces. Every file must end with a newline.

section.title: Document identifiers
section.simpara: Every project document carries a biblioid element with class="pubsnumber" that uniquely identifies it within the documentation tree. The value encodes the document's filesystem path by converting each numeric directory prefix into a Greek numeral and concatenating the results. Narrative IDs — bare integers without a directory prefix — are preserved as Arabic numerals. Directory names without a numeric prefix are not encoded.
The numeral mapping follows the Milesian system: α = 1, β = 2, γ = 3, δ = 4, ε = 5, ϛ = 6, ζ = 7, η = 8, θ = 9, ι = 10, and so on.

listitem.simpara: documentation/06-change-control/05-stories/1-product-vision/02-evaluation/ — prefixes 06, 05, and 02 encode as ϛ, ε, and β; the narrative ID 1 is kept as 1.

section.simpara: The biblioid changes only when a document moves to a different directory. It is used as a stable, concise cross-reference identifier throughout the documentation.

section.title: Shared content
section.simpara: Reusable fragments live in documentation/shared/ and are included via XInclude:

section.title: Glossary
section.simpara: A document's glossary must contain every term referenced in the document body, plus every term in the same connected component of the glossseealso graph. glossseealso links are bidirectional: if entry A links to B, entry B must also link back to A.

section.title: Bibliography
section.simpara: A document's bibliography must contain only entries cited in the document body.

section.title: Generated files
section.simpara: Generated files use .gen immediately before the filename extension and remain beside their source file. Each generated file must identify its source and generator, state that it must not be edited directly, and omit a manually maintained changelog.

section.title: Changelogs
section.simpara: Project-authored files without a built-in changelog mechanism (such as revhistory) carry a footer changelog in Keep a Changelog format, using Story numbers instead of release versions. The union of authors across all changelog entries must equal the SPDX copyright holders of the file.
Use <!-- --> for XML and XSL files, /* */ for CSS files, and # for files using line comments such as TOML and .gitignore:
section.programlisting:
<!-- # Changelog
## Story N — YYYY-MM-DD
### Authors
- Author Name
### Added
- ... -->
